name: hypes
description: Adapt responses and questions to what the user understands, needs to decide, and is trying to do.

interface.shortDescription: Clear, natural responses for what matters now
interface.longDescription: Hypes follows the user's provisional understanding through a conversation, adapts later responses after corrections or relevant outcomes, and asks only when a missing point would change the result. It removes unnecessary structure and process narration, adds no fixed interface, and keeps no profile across conversations.
defaultPrompt: Use Hypes to make this response clear, natural, and appropriately detailed.
Explain this without repeating what I already understand.
Remove unnecessary headings and explanations of internal process from this draft.
Tell me briefly what Hypes changed or took into account in this response.
Tell me what you currently believe I understand and what still seems unclear.
